name: 賞与 (bonus)
authority: 健康保険法 art.3(6) and 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iv): a bonus paid three times a year or less is 賞与, assessed on the standard bonus amount (健保法 art.45, 厚年法 art.24の4), not the monthly grade; wages for labour insurance; withheld by the bonus rate table (所得税法 art.186(1)(ii)). The 賞与支払届 is due within 5 days (健保則 art.27, 厚年則 art.19の5). A bonus for a period over six months is BONUS_OVER_SIX_MONTHS (所得税法 art.186(2)).

name: 賞与（計算期間6か月超） (bonus for a period over six months)
authority: 所得税法 art.186(2): where the bonus computation period exceeds six months and the 月額表 method applies, the bonus is divided by twelve, not six. Otherwise as BONUS: 標準賞与額 for social insurance, a wage for labour insurance.

name: 休業手当 (shutdown allowance)
authority: 労働基準法 art.26: for a shutdown attributable to the employer, at least 60% of the average wage (art.12; entry.facts.average_daily_wage) for each day (entry.quantity days); the larger of the amount entered and that minimum is paid. It is a wage: remuneration, labour insurance wages and salary income. The average wage is computed from the three calendar months' wages before the shutdown over their calendar days (art.12(1); earned.months) unless entered (entry.facts.average_daily_wage); for a partial-day shutdown the floor is 60% less the wages paid for that day (entry.facts.wages_paid_for_days; 昭和27年8月7日 基収3445号). authority: 労働基準法 art.20(1)–(2): a dismissal needs 30 days' notice or the average wage (art.12; entry.facts.average_daily_wage) for each day of notice short of 30 (entry.facts.notice_days_given); paid at the latest on the dismissal day (昭和23年3月17日 基発464号). Taxed as retirement income (所得税基本通達30-5), outside social and labour insurance. No floor where art.21 excludes the worker (日々雇用 up to a month, a term of up to two months, seasonal up to four, probation up to 14 days) or the labour standards office certified an exception (art.20(1) proviso, (3); entry.facts.notice_exempt). The 平均賃金 leaves out the periods art.12(3) lists, their days and their wages: occupational injury absence, 産前産後休業, an employer-caused suspension (suspension_kind EMPLOYER_CAUSED only, with the 休業手当 paid for it), 育児休業 (incl. 出生時育児休業), 介護休業 (earned.months leave_days, suspended_days_by_kind) and the probation period (terms.facts.probation_until, its wages prorated by calendar days); where they cover the whole three months the wages and days of the period are used undivided (施行規則 art.3; 昭和24年4月11日 基発421号), and a worker paid by the day or hour is guaranteed 60% of the three months’ wages over the days worked (art.12(1)(i); worked_days).

name: 退職手当 (retirement allowance)
authority: No statute requires a retirement allowance; where the work rules provide one (労働基準法 art.89(iii)の2) it is paid as they state. Retirement income (所得税法 art.30), withheld by RETIREMENT_TAX; not remuneration for social insurance or wages for labour insurance. The resident tax on retirement income (10%) is withheld by RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT. It is payable after the exit (payable_after_exit): withheld when paid (所得税法 arts.199, 203) on a slip of its own; no premium is charged on it.

name: 食事の現物支給 (meals in kind)
authority: 所得税基本通達 36-38の2 (as amended 令和8年3月31日, from 1 April 2026: 7,500 yen; before: 3,500 yen): meals in kind are not taxable where the employee pays half or more of their value and the employer's cost is 7,500 yen a month or less; otherwise the employer's cost (value less the employee's payment) is taxable salary (entry.facts.meal_value, entry.facts.employee_payment). For social insurance the meal is valued at the 厚生労働大臣 告示 価額 of the prefecture and included in the grade the pension office decides (健康保険法 art.46). The social-insurance value is the 告示 price, entered as MEALS_IN_KIND_SOCIAL_INSURANCE.

name: 社宅の貸与 (company housing)
authority: 所得税基本通達 36-40, 36-41, 36-45: a 使用人 who pays half or more of the 通常の賃貸料の額 has no taxable benefit; otherwise the 通常の賃貸料 less the rent paid is taxable salary (entry.facts.standard_rent, entry.facts.rent_paid). An officer's 通常の賃貸料 follows 36-40 (the employer computes it). Housing in kind is remuneration at the 告示 価額 for social insurance (健康保険法 art.46). The social-insurance value is the 告示 price, entered as HOUSING_IN_KIND_SOCIAL_INSURANCE.

name: 課税される経済的利益 (other taxable benefit)
authority: 所得税法 art.36(1)–(2) with 所得税基本通達 36-15 ff.: other benefits in kind (goods, services, low-interest loans, awards in money) are salary at their value as the 通達 states; the employer enters the taxable value.

name: 臨時の手当 (other taxable cash allowance)
authority: 所得税法 art.28: a cash allowance paid in the month is salary income, remuneration for social insurance (健保法 art.3(5)) and a wage for labour insurance — including any excess over the night-duty or night-meal limits.

name: 宿日直手当 (night and holiday duty allowance)
authority: 所得税基本通達 28-1: a 宿直・日直 allowance up to 4,000 yen an occasion is not taxable (entry.quantity occasions; the class pays at most that, any excess is SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE). It is 報酬 for social insurance (健康保険法 art.3(5); 日本年金機構 lists 宿日直手当 as 報酬) and a wage for labour insurance (労働保険徴収法 art.2(2)).

name: 深夜勤務の夜食代 (night-shift meal money)
authority: 昭和59年7月26日 直法6-5 as amended 令和8年3月31日: cash paid instead of a meal for night work (22:00–05:00) is not taxable up to 650 yen an occasion (entry.quantity; from 1 April 2026 650, before 300). The exemption holds only where the whole payment of the occasion is within the limit; a larger payment is wholly taxable, so it is entered in full as SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE (the class refuses an amount above the limit). Enter one entry per occasion (entry.quantity 1). It is a wage: 報酬 for social insurance (健康保険法 art.3(5); 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iii)) and 賃金 for labour insurance (労働保険徴収法 art.2(2)).

name: 永年勤続表彰（記念品） (long-service award in kind)
authority: 所得税基本通達 36-21: an award in kind (not cash) for 10 or more years of service, at intervals of 5 years or more and of a reasonable value, is not taxable; a cash award or one outside these conditions is TAXABLE_BENEFIT or BONUS.

name: 減給の制裁 (disciplinary pay reduction)
authority: 労働基準法 art.91: a disciplinary reduction under the work rules is at most half a day's average wage per act (entry.quantity acts; the average wage as for SHUTDOWN_ALLOWANCE) and at most one tenth of the period's wages in all (validation DISCIPLINARY_DEDUCTION_LIMIT refuses the slip above it). The 平均賃金 leaves out the periods art.12(3) lists, their days and their wages: occupational injury absence, 産前産後休業, an employer-caused suspension (suspension_kind EMPLOYER_CAUSED only, with the 休業手当 paid for it), 育児休業 (incl. 出生時育児休業), 介護休業 (earned.months leave_days, suspended_days_by_kind) and the probation period (terms.facts.probation_until, its wages prorated by calendar days); where they cover the whole three months the wages and days of the period are used undivided (施行規則 art.3; 昭和24年4月11日 基発421号), and a worker paid by the day or hour is guaranteed 60% of the three months’ wages over the days worked (art.12(1)(i); worked_days).

name: 退職者の未払賃金の遅延利息 (delay interest on unpaid wages)
authority: 賃金の支払の確保等に関する法律 art.6(1) with 施行令 art.1: wages (not retirement allowances) unpaid on the day of leaving, or their later due day, bear interest at 14.6% a year from the next day to payment (entry.facts.unpaid_amount, entry.facts.days_late). Not salary income (雑所得).
